output.title: How does SQL injection work, and how do developers prevent it?
output.summary: SQL injection happens when an application builds an SQL statement by concatenating untrusted input, so an attacker's text is interpreted as SQL syntax and changes the meaning of the query, possibly exposing or altering data.
